GraphRecursionError: Recursion limit of 60 reached without hitting a stop condition. You can increase the limit by setting the `recursion_limit` config key.
For troubleshooting, visit: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/errors/GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT

git_requirement: Actual hypotheses/freeze commits and freeze tag exist
protocol: New development before Git tag; new official runs after tag; original historical evaluation already seen
retry_policy: Baseline/data-eval already tried three times at cap 60; preserve failed records before any explicitly chosen further retry
